title: Thacker Pass Water and Reclamation Permit Notices of Decision
summary: NDEP's combined decision record documents issuance of the Thacker Pass water-pollution-control and mine-reclamation permits after the state review process.
key_findings: The state issued decisions for both mining permits on February 25, 2022.
The decision record fixes the authorization milestone separately from later permit compliance.
Permit issuance does not establish that construction, operation, or reclamation obligations were performed.
why_it_matters: It establishes the formal state decision date without collapsing it into delivery.
ftfn_relevance: Adds the decision layer behind the existing permit hub.
Supports a complete permit provenance trail.
Keeps approval separate from implementation and output.
evidence_limits: The decisions do not prove construction or operation.
They do not establish later compliance, water impacts, reclamation performance, or production.
